what_changed: FDIC proposes recordkeeping requirements (12 CFR 375) for insured depository institutions holding custodial deposit accounts with transactional features, to support deposit insurance determinations.
rationale: The abstract describes deposit-insurance recordkeeping for custodial deposit accounts (beneficial ownership), not records of borrower contacts, disclosures or payments, and no dispute or error-resolution duty. The v1.2 record-retention addition does not reach it and the deposit-account exclusion still applies. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
